clean_text: [MDA_P011] AR 2023 SUSTAINABILITY Power Root’s strategic sustainability initiatives focus on how we can better utilise renewable energy while generating savings. The investment we made in installing a solar photovoltaic (PV) system at our Johor Bahru plant in FY 2022 to reduce our fossil fuel consumption and carbon footprint is paying off with substantial energy cost savings this financial year. The PV system commenced operations in May 2022; as at 31 March 2023, the system has generated approximately 600,000 kWh of electricity and yielded us total cost savings of approximately RM261,000. In FY 2023, the Group shifted from using diesel-operated forklifts to battery-operated forklifts. We now employ a fleet of 34 battery-operated forklifts. Previously, all our forklifts were powered by diesel fuel. This move has resulted in reducing our carbon footprint while improving the working environment, enhancing safety measures, maximising operational efficiency and reducing costs. During this financial year, we continued our ongoing initiative to replace our existing vehicle fleet with hybrid cars, including the installation of electric vehicle (EV) chargers at our Kuala Lumpur office.
